What twisted lab did these things come from?!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 11 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Slime''' is an enemy that appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. It can also appear in Molten Arena [[PVP]] and [[The Takeover Event]], if a [[Failed Experiment]] is killed in it. It has a high amount of health and a decent speed. Additionally, it is spawned by all enemies that have the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute, with the exception of other '''Slimes'''. It is also a primary focus of the [[Oops! All slimes!]] challenge map, as all enemies spawn with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute, therefore making the '''Slime''' spawn from every enemy. As most enemies with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute spawn the '''Slime''', it can also appear in the [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]], [[Back to Basics (Challenge)|Back to Basics]], [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] and [[Oops! All slimes!]] challenge maps. It also appeared in [[The Classic Event]] through the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute. ==Appearance== The '''Slime''' is a humanoid made of a translucent green goo, with bones inside each part of its body. It has a ribcage with a spine, a long bone in each limb, and a skull, which is cracked at the top, going from the middle of the facial area to its right eyehole. It does a front flip and emits liquid green particles whenever it spawns in. It does not emit shards or dust on death. ==Strategy== *Towers with good DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Military Base]] or [[Hunter]] can be quite effective against it. *Towers with high damage, such as the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Ranger]] can kill the '''Slime''' in a single shot. *The '''Slimes''' that spawn from enemies with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute and the [[Failed Experiment]] do not count as summoned enemies, which means they do give you cash upon death. **Because of this, the [[Cowboy]] can be used to generate cash from '''Slimes''' if they appear from these sources. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SlimeWalkingAnimation.gif|Walking animation (3 May 2024 – Present) SlimeSpawnAnimation.gif|Spawning animation (3 May 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MSlime.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Slime.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSlime.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Slime''' on a promotional video. V1.90.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Slime''' in a [[v1.90.0]] update log image. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Slime''' used to have an ability that allowed it to transform into the strongest non-boss enemy currently on the map. **This ability technically was not removed. Instead, the transformation time was increased from 12.5 seconds to 10,000, meaning it takes around three hours for it to transform. ***With the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode stat editor, it is possible to give towers fast firerates and no damage, allowing for it to be stalled long enough for the ability to trigger. *The skeletal system inside of the '''Slime''' is incredibly different to that of the [[Skeleton]]'s regular appearance. **The [[Fallen Skeleton]], however, has a skull that is similar to that of the '''Slime'''. *The '''Slime''' is the only enemy to not emit the shard and dust particles on death since the [[V1.1.0|Entity System Update]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''3 May 2024''' -
